Property.name: Mode
Property.HelpText: Off: play alone. Host: others join you (they need your address and the port). Join: connect to a host. In game, F9 turns multiplayer off/on.

Property.name: Name
Property.HelpText: Shown above your character and in join messages (up to 10 characters).

Property.name: Host
Property.HelpText: The host's IP and port, e.g. 100.101.102.103:43902 (Tailscale) or a public IP whose router forwards the port.

Property.name: Port
Property.HelpText: UDP port to listen on. Other players must be able to reach it (port forwarding or Tailscale).

Property.name: NameTags
Property.HelpText: Show other players' names above them (smaller when they are far away).

Property.name: MyChao
Property.HelpText: The Chao that represents you in friends' Chao Races and karate. Easier to pick in game: F9 > My Chao.

Property.name: VisitWith
Property.HelpText: Which of your Chao visit friends in a shared garden: Garden = up to 2 from the garden you're in, MyChao = only your chosen Chao, Off = none.

Property.name: ChaoRace
Property.HelpText: Friends' Chao take the CPU lanes in your Chao Races (labelled with the owner's name). Outside a room they're copies your game races; in a room they follow your friends' real Chao live.
